title: Agent 基建集中爆发，但 SaaS 末日论是伪命题
summary: Anthropic 把 Claude Cowork 使用额度翻倍，Vercel 开放 Skills API，Codex 优化记忆机制，Replit 牵手 Shopify——Agent 基础设施层本周集中爆发。 但 Figma PM Matt Colyer 在播客中反驳了「SaaS 末日论」：AI 让开发者数量从 2500 万

items.title: Claude
items.summary:
We've doubled usage limits in Claude Cowork for the next month.

Delegate bigger, more complex tasks to Claude. https://t.co/ivHZuaMbZV
items.translation: Claude Cowork 使用额度翻倍，持续到 7 月 5 日。Cowork 在超大任务上最出彩：跨几十个账号的研究、定期报告、收件箱分诊和草拟回复。所有付费计划均可使用。

items.title: Boris Cherny
items.summary: We doubled Claude Cowork usage limits for the next month. This applies to your 5-hr rate limits. If you’ve been saving up a big messy project, now’s the time.
items.translation: Boris Cherny 宣布 Claude Cowork 翻倍：如果你一直在攒一个复杂项目，现在是时候了。

items.title: Aaron Levie
items.summary:
Coding is basically the pinnacle of what you could reasonably automate with AI, and yet we still need human engineers to oversee agents for them to be effective.

The AI models are trained on an incredible amount of sophisticated code. The users are highly technical and can use
items.translation: Box CEO Aaron Levie：编程是 AI 能合理自动化的天花板——有大量高质量代码做训练数据、用户本身就是技术专家、产出可验证(跑一下就行)、上下文已经数字化。即便如此，人类工程师依然不可或缺。Agent 让人做得更多，但人不会消失。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch
items.summary:
Agent filesystem state can now be read, written and mounted independently of Sandbox lifecycle.

We’ve been developing a novel virtual storage infrastructure solution for all our compute products.

Storage that’s decoupled, but attachable to Builds, Functions, Sandboxes & more.
items.translation: Vercel Agent 文件系统状态：现在可以独立于 Sandbox 生命周期进行读写和挂载，Vercel 在构建一套解耦的虚拟存储基础设施。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch
items.summary:
Use the Skills API to make all your agents and platforms smarter.

Think of it as the npm registry for agent capabilities and extensibility. Free and open.
items.translation: Vercel Skills API：Rauch 把它比作「Agent 能力的 npm 注册表」，免费且开放。让你的所有 Agent 和平台都更聪明。

items.title: Peter Yang
items.summary:
How to build AI skills that check their own work and improve over time:

1. Give it context

Ask AI: "Create a skill for this [repeated task]. Here are examples of good output so it knows what good looks like."

2. Make it easy to trigger

“Write a clear skill description using https://t.co/2QHh0PjqEo
items.translation: Roblox 产品负责人 Peter Yang 分享五步法构建自我进化的 AI Skill：(1)给上下文和好样本(2)写清晰的触发描述(3)加 evals 自动检查(4)加记忆机制(5)再建一个 Skill 来维护其他 Skill。

He does swear by @every's Compound Engineering for making https://t.co/9NZe0ud36d

click, chat, hold shift to multi-select.

works best with Composer 2.5

items.title: swyx
items.summary:
a smarter alternative to "always use plan mode": 

always frame your task as a question, so that the model is invited to push back and rate the quality of the idea/suggest alternatives, rather than blindly execute what you SAID to do 

(which is often not precisely what you
items.translation: Swyx 贡献巧妙提示词技巧：把任务框成问题而不是指令。模型会被邀请来质疑任务质量、建议替代方案，而不是盲目执行。在你的 prompt 末尾加个问号就行。

items.title: Madhu Guru
items.summary:
One of the most common mistakes I see enterprise AI teams make is building for today’s model capabilities and price points.

Think 6 months out. Models will be way smarter and cheaper.

Scaffold around today’s model weaknesses to push the frontier. Bet that the next generation of
items.translation: 前 Google Gemini 产品负责人 Madhu Guru 提醒：不要为今天的模型能力和价格做架构。看 6 个月后——模型会更聪明更便宜。Build for the slope。

items.title: Matt Turck
items.summary:
Ok bad stories about VCs are spreading on X right now, but VCs have horror stories about founders too 

Like, that one time when a founder decided to take another term sheet with a higher valuation despite our obvious ability to add value, thought leadership and vendor discounts
items.translation: FirstMark 合伙人 Matt Turck 调侃：VC 有坏故事，但 VC 也有创始人的恐怖故事——比如创始人拿了更高估值 term sheet，无视了我们明显能提供的价值。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari
items.summary: QED. The quote tweets in this thread just show we HAVE to do better. Evergreen reminder that without founders, there are no VCs! https://t.co/vDQnupyZrs
items.translation: FPV Ventures Nikunj Kothari 回应：没有创始人就没有 VC。我们必须做得更好。
